desc: MDT Chassis Systems were designed for sports and tactical shooting. However over the years they found that their rifle chassis were often used in hunting, especially the lighter chassis such as the LSS Chassis system. But they had never purpose-built a chassis system solely for hunting, until now. The MDT HNT26 Chassis System is MDT's first truly purpose built hunting rifle chassis. This rifle stock provides you with all of the usual benefits that you expect from a chassis system such as v-block bedding, LOP and comb adjustment, AICS magazine compatibility etc, but weighs in starting at a mere 26oz.
